text: Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority to appoint and remove directors from the boards of Businesses Improvement Areas (BIAs) that fall within its geographic boundaries. The purpose of this report is to recommend that Toronto and East York Community Council appoint directors to the College West, Danforth Village and Oakwood Village BIA Boards of Management and remove directors from The Beach and Bloor by the Park BIA Boards of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below, at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: College West: Judas, Maria Danforth Village: Ahmed, Jishan Azad, Abul Cao, Kevin Chun, David Gassendy, Jean-Pierre Louisy, Lois Sarkar, Sakib Shamsuddoha, Anwar Syed, Raffee Tourountzas, Paul Oakwood Village: Sorrenti, Anne 2. Removed the following directors from the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below: The Beach: LaForge, Lise Bloor by the Park: Arcadi, James
